fluff.overview: The LCAF fields conventional infantry that benefit from the Commonwealth's deep industrial base, equipping even garrison formations with reliable, well-maintained weapons and transport. Foot infantry platoons form the backbone of the LCAF's garrison forces, deploying on foot to hold positions, patrol perimeters, and secure urban areas where vehicles cannot easily operate. Equipped with submachine guns optimized for close-quarters combat, these platoons trade effective range for high rates of fire at short distances, making them well-suited to urban operations and building clearance. Trained as military sappers, these troops specialize in obstacle construction, demolition, and field fortification preparation, combining engineering and combat skills to shape the battlefield.
